note: The 26 routing cases are synthetic: generic requests written for these tests, with made-up analysis names, model points and numbers. Expectations name what the reading, plan and claims must contain, never a task_mode. B14b, S05b and B24 are counterfactuals of B14, S05 and B04.

cases.prompt: A process has a cross section of 1.2e-3 pb and the dataset corresponds to 139 fb^-1. How many events is that? Show the unit conversion.
Take a sequential-standard-model Z' with a mass of 3 TeV. Give its tree-level width into electron pairs and its branching fraction to charged leptons, and write out the formula you use.
Redo the observed 95% CL exclusion contour in the (m_slepton, delta m) plane from the ATLAS compressed-slepton search, arXiv:{{arxiv:32}} ({{analysis:1}}), for slepton-pair production.

Does the CMS multilepton search {{analysis:479}} exclude a wino-like chargino-neutralino pair at 600 GeV decaying via WZ into a 200 GeV bino? Prefer the published likelihood or published counts where they exist.

In the fictional Quartz model, a charged scalar produces a photon and a jet. Summarize the published exclusion limits from fictional searches {{analysis:901:91}} and {{analysis:902:92}} in a figure of photon-jet invariant mass below 875 GeV.

Assume a displaced electron-photon excess comes from the fictional Lantern tensor model. Compare the existing exclusion limits on its transverse decay length from fictional searches {{analysis:903:93}} and {{analysis:904:94}}, and draw a summary figure.

For the fictional Mosaic model producing two tau jets and missing momentum, scan the parent and invisible-particle masses using fictional search {{analysis:905:95}}. Report expected limits in transverse mass and estimate the gain from a tau-polarization classifier.
Constrain c_HW and c_HB at linear order in SMEFT with the 13 TeV Higgs STXS measurements from ATLAS and CMS, including the correlations between their uncertainties.
I have attached events.hepmc with 50k ttbar events at 13 TeV. Run the Rivet analysis SYN_9256_I1242 over it and give me the normalised distributions against the measured data.

Here is the Lagrangian of a scalar leptoquark S1 that couples an electron to an up quark with strength lambda: L = lambda * S1 * (e^c u^c)^* + h.c. Construct the model, generate pp -> S1 -> e j at 13 TeV with lepton PDFs for M = 3 TeV, Gamma = 60 GeV and lambda = 1, and show the electron-jet invariant mass after an ATLAS-like detector simulation and selection.

In the ALP effective theory set c_W-tilde = 1 and c_B-tilde = -tan^2(theta_W) so that the ALP-photon coupling vanishes, with f_a = 1 TeV and m_a = 1 MeV. At parton level, compute the normalised missing-transverse-energy distribution for pp -> a W gamma with W -> l nu at 13 TeV.

For a kinetically mixed U(1)' Z', find the expected 2-sigma exclusion contour at the 8 TeV LHC with 20 fb^-1 in the (g-tilde, g1') coupling plane for M_Z' = 2, 2.5 and 3 TeV using Drell-Yan dileptons. Use the significance 2(sqrt(S+B) - sqrt(B)) and assume 60% acceptance.

Recast the 13 TeV mono-tau searches from ATLAS and CMS (arXiv:{{arxiv:490}} and arXiv:{{arxiv:491}}) to bound a U1 vector leptoquark coupled to b-tau and c-nu, giving the 2-sigma excluded region in (sqrt(|g_c g_b|), M_U1) for M_U1 between 750 GeV and 5 TeV.

Implement the search from the attached paper EXAMPLE-ANA-001 and use it to predict the binned E_T^miss signal yield for the model point ModelA_700_150 (700 GeV chargino, 150 GeV LSP) in the two-lepton signal region at 59.7 fb^-1 and 13 TeV. Fill in the attached results template and keep its bin edges unchanged. Do not take bin values from the paper's figures or from HEPData.

Example suite, item 3. Implement the search from the attached paper EXAMPLE-ANA-001 and use it to predict the binned E_T^miss signal yield for the model point ModelA_700_150 (700 GeV chargino, 150 GeV LSP) in the two-lepton signal region at 59.7 fb^-1 and 13 TeV. Fill in the attached results template and keep its bin edges unchanged. Do not take bin values from the paper's figures or from HEPData.

Determine how strongly the diphoton acoplanarity spectrum constrains the interference coupling of the fictional Compass model. Fit the synthetic spectrum at 17 TeV, HEPData 000009901, 0.042 fb^-1, with the Rivet routine SYN_9900_I7000001; compare the allowed coupling with the zero-interference hypothesis.

Using supplied synthetic electron-photon events at 17 TeV and 0.042 fb^-1, optimize a blinded search in missing transverse momentum for the fictional Prism and Lantern models. Validate a background estimate in control regions, report expected sensitivity, and write a six-page internal note.

Example suite, item 8. Using supplied synthetic electron-photon events at 17 TeV and 0.042 fb^-1, optimize a blinded search in missing transverse momentum for the fictional Prism and Lantern models. Validate a background estimate in control regions, report expected sensitivity, and write a six-page internal note.

Build and evaluate a weakly supervised anomaly-detection method in the CWoLa style for dijet resonance searches on my supplied dijet events with an injected signal, and compare its sensitivity with a cut-based baseline.
Use CAMB to compute the lensed CMB TT and EE power spectra up to l = 2500 for the Planck 2018 best-fit LCDM parameters, and compare them with CLASS.
With flavio, find the shift in P5' for B -> K* mu mu in the 4 < q^2 < 6 GeV^2 bin when the new-physics Wilson coefficient C9 = -1 at the b-quark scale.
Write a paper in EPJC format from the results in my run directory runs/stau-fit, including an abstract, figures, citations and a methods section, and build the PDF.
Which LHC searches constrain compressed slepton spectra with mass splittings under 20 GeV, and what are their strongest current limits?
Generate 10,000 Drell-Yan e+e- events at 13 TeV using MadGraph and Pythia and plot the dielectron invariant mass from 60 to 120 GeV.
Draw every tree-level Feynman diagram for g g -> t t-bar H in the Standard Model.
